audit_logs.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	status INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

data_sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE data_sources (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(80), 
	url VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN, 
	refresh_hours INTEGER, 
	last_checked_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	last_status VARCHAR(50), 
	last_error TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

important_items.sql:
CREATE TABLE important_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	item_type VARCHAR(80), 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	participants VARCHAR(500), 
	date DATE, 
	reminder VARCHAR(120), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

login_attempts.sql:
CREATE TABLE login_attempts (
	key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	until TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)

reference_items.sql:
CREATE TABLE reference_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(250) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(50), 
	secondary_code VARCHAR(50), 
	url VARCHAR(500), 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

students.sql:
CREATE TABLE students (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	grade VARCHAR(50), 
	target_school VARCHAR(200), 
	target_major VARCHAR(200), 
	advisor VARCHAR(120), 
	priority_level VARCHAR(20), 
	priority_direction VARCHAR(10), 
	overall_status VARCHAR(120), 
	birth_date DATE, 
	phone VARCHAR(80), 
	address TEXT, 
	chinese_address TEXT, 
	national_id_number VARCHAR(80), 
	passport_number VARCHAR(80), 
	passport_issue_date DATE, 
	passport_expiry_date DATE, 
	bank_certificate_amount VARCHAR(80), 
	credit_card_holder VARCHAR(120), 
	cardholder_phone VARCHAR(80), 
	card_channel VARCHAR(80), 
	card_number VARCHAR(100), 
	card_expiry VARCHAR(30), 
	card_cvv VARCHAR(20), 
	final_school VARCHAR(200), 
	notes TEXT, 
	portal_token VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_students_portal_token ON students (portal_token)

users.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)

applications.sql:
CREATE TABLE applications (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	program_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	program_type VARCHAR(50), 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	deadline DATE, 
	deadline_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	result_date DATE, 
	result_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	result VARCHAR(120), 
	materials_status VARCHAR(200), 
	next_step VARCHAR(250), 
	notes TEXT, 
	country_batch VARCHAR(120), 
	country VARCHAR(100), 
	batch VARCHAR(80), 
	portal_id VARCHAR(150), 
	portal_password VARCHAR(150), 
	portal_material_progress VARCHAR(120), 
	form_status VARCHAR(120), 
	submission_date DATE, 
	supplemental_essay VARCHAR(20), 
	transcript_required VARCHAR(20), 
	ceeb_code VARCHAR(50), 
	language_delivery VARCHAR(120), 
	sat_delivery VARCHAR(120), 
	act_code VARCHAR(50), 
	act_delivery VARCHAR(120), 
	ap_delivery VARCHAR(120), 
	other_delivery VARCHAR(200), 
	delivery_date DATE, 
	application_system VARCHAR(150), 
	application_username VARCHAR(150), 
	application_password VARCHAR(150), 
	portal_security_qa TEXT, 
	portal_url VARCHAR(500), 
	online_application_status VARCHAR(200), 
	portal_status VARCHAR(200), 
	score_delivery_status VARCHAR(200), 
	portal_q1 TEXT, 
	portal_a1 TEXT, 
	portal_q2 TEXT, 
	portal_a2 TEXT, 
	portal_q3 TEXT, 
	portal_a3 TEXT, 
	portal_q4 TEXT, 
	portal_a4 TEXT, 
	portal_q5 TEXT, 
	portal_a5 TEXT, 
	online_details_expanded BOOLEAN, 
	portal_details_expanded BOOLEAN, 
	delivery_details_expanded BOOLEAN, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

communications.sql:
CREATE TABLE communications (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	date DATE, 
	date_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	contact_person VARCHAR(50), 
	method VARCHAR(50), 
	summary TEXT, 
	next_follow_up DATE, 
	follow_up_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	generated_tasks TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

courses.sql:
CREATE TABLE courses (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	semester VARCHAR(100), 
	category VARCHAR(120), 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	level VARCHAR(100), 
	grade VARCHAR(80), 
	credits VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

exams.sql:
CREATE TABLE exams (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exam_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	exam_date DATE, 
	exam_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	score VARCHAR(80), 
	target_score VARCHAR(80), 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	next_action VARCHAR(250), 
	notes TEXT, 
	reading VARCHAR(30), 
	listening VARCHAR(30), 
	speaking VARCHAR(30), 
	writing VARCHAR(30), 
	math VARCHAR(30), 
	science VARCHAR(30), 
	english VARCHAR(30), 
	total VARCHAR(30), 
	appointment_number VARCHAR(100), 
	record_locator VARCHAR(100), 
	subject VARCHAR(150), 
	component_score VARCHAR(100), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

login_sessions.sql:
CREATE TABLE login_sessions (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

projects.sql:
CREATE TABLE projects (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	project_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	project_type VARCHAR(50), 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	start_date DATE, 
	start_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	end_date DATE, 
	end_time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	outcome VARCHAR(250), 
	risk_level VARCHAR(20), 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

public_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE public_events (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(80), 
	event_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	date_kind VARCHAR(80), 
	source_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	source_text TEXT, 
	review_status VARCHAR(50), 
	reminder_days VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES data_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

remembered_logins.sql:
CREATE TABLE remembered_logins (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_password TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

tasks.sql:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(50), 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	priority VARCHAR(20), 
	priority_direction VARCHAR(10), 
	owner VARCHAR(50), 
	due_date DATE, 
	time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	description TEXT, 
	reminder_days VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

timelines.sql:
CREATE TABLE timelines (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER, 
	owner VARCHAR(50), 
	period VARCHAR(100), 
	category VARCHAR(50), 
	content TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	date DATE, 
	time_node VARCHAR(50), 
	notes TEXT, 
	source_event_id INTEGER, 
	reminder_days VARCHAR(50), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_event_id) REFERENCES public_events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
